description: A React component for a notes list page that allows browsing, searching, and deleting saved notes. It interacts with a notes repository and uses context for authentication and toast notifications.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of notes from the repository, handles loading state, and shows toast notifications on errors.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles the search form submission, triggers reloading of notes based on query.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID from the repository and refreshes the list, with toast notifications for success and errors.
